text:
maria: Heads-up — candidate model 'aurelia-70b' popped in our bench sweep. Asking for short-prio: bring-up + quant experiments + quick regressions run. baseline: gpt-... latency/cost looks promising. :eyes:

devon: +1. Do we have a signal-to-noise sketch? need to know expected RPS and latency SLO for hosted run.

anya: Quick note — we should gate on eval delta for our standard prompt set, especially dialogue and instruction-following. If delta > 3% on QA F1, deprioritize.

todd: can we run a 10k eval pass on the queued prompts? happy to kick off a batch today.

sophia: I can do quant rounds (4-bit and 8-bit) once we have the model artifact. timeline ~48h per quant profile.

ben: How about infra constraints? memory on i4x is tight, might need shard config. tagging `infra:memory` on the intake.

maria: Good call. Quick rubric proposal — please comment inline:

```
- User quality delta: 0-1% (green), 1-3% (yellow), >3% (red)
- Latency: within 1.2x baseline (green), 1.2-1.5x (yellow), >1.5x (red)
- Cost per token: <= baseline*0.9 (green), 0.9-1.1 (yellow), >1.1 (red)
- Quant friendliness: no significant loss at 4-bit -> +1
- Safety regressions: any fail -> automatch red
```

rachel: I like it. We should add a `rollback complexity` field — how many model-dependent ops in prod touchpoints.

quant-bot: Scheduled quant job `qrun-2155123456` queued. ETA: 50m for artifact pull.

eval-runner: 10k eval job `eval-2155123456` started on bench-cluster-3. Progress: 0/10000 prompts.

devon: For roadmap alignment — this model touches Search Re-rank and Assistant features. Tentative priority: medium-high if quant preserves quality.

anya: If the eval shows a small hallucination pattern on numerical answers, deprioritize until we can run patch prompts.

maria: Action items:
- devon: draft SLO/RPS assumption (due EOD)
- todd: kick and monitor eval job (in progress)
- sophia: stand up quant jobs after artifact arrives
- ben: confirm shard config and memory envelope
- anyone: comment on rubric

maria: tagging weekly review thread for summary later :calendar: — will compile results for Wed's model sync.

sophia: noted. If qrun reveals OOMs, I'll switch to 2-shard strategy and report.

todd: eval progress 2,400/10,000 — no major deltas yet. I'll post summary when complete.

ben: infra check done — we can support 70b in 2-shard on i4x with swap enabled. Logging config: `/infra/70b-shard.conf`.

rachel: Added `rollback complexity` to intake doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboard-checklist#aurelia-70b

maria: Thanks all — will post a condensed scorecard when eval + quant finish. :party-parrot:
